name: vibedev_execution_policy
content: - Route implementation through the existing engineering agents.
- Use the managed Pi-backed run_coding_task flow for file changes.
- Preserve the Original VibeDev user prompt verbatim when delegating to a coding engineer.

- The coding engineer's first tool call should be run_coding_task. Do not ask the engineer to inspect files with shell/files before that first Pi run unless repo_path or the request is genuinely missing/ambiguous.

metadata.description: Server-authoritative VibeDev coding-coordinator execution policy. Appended to the goal of every VibeDev Build run (RCA fix #5) so the implementation contract reaches the engineering-manager coordinator even when the cockpit client did not compose it. Mode-agnostic: how the changes land (a staged CodeChangeProposal, or commits on a trusted branch) is stated once by the change-delivery block chosen from the run's effective trust mode (artifact_v2::service::vibedev_change_delivery_block).
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.2: Drops the 'Stage code changes as CodeChangeProposal diff_approval items.' line; staging is now stated only by the sandboxed change-delivery block, so a trusted branch run is never told both. v1.0.1: Describes the coding path as a managed runtime flow rather than attributing it to the backend service. v1.0.0: Initial relocation of the static VibeDev execution-policy footer from the cockpit client into the prompt store. Hardened to preserve the original VibeDev prompt and force coding delegates through run_coding_task before shell/file pre-inspection.
